entities.summary: John Emory Cookman was an American ice hockey player who competed in the 1932 Winter Olympics, playing five matches and scoring two goals. The American ice hockey team won the silver medal that year. He graduated from Yale in 1931, and later became the CFO of Philip Morris USA.
